events.title: XR Guild Hall Opening at Immersive X
events.description:
XR Guild Hall in the immersive web is now open for all members! We are celebrating opening day on November 12th with a special opening panel of talks from the volunteers of the XR Guild who have been building this community space for our members around the world to use 24/7. Join Seii (David L), Sonthia C, Nick K, Patrick O'S and Evo for a conversation inside our new guild hall as we discuss how we've engaged with this community and open source methods to build the new Guild Hall in the immersive web platforms of Arrival.space and Viverse to start. We will be discussing events, the new library and searchable timeline, the art and community uses along with next steps as we expand the presence of our community to new immersive platforms along with old favorites like AltspaceVR or RP1 as the field evolves. This event is open to all, members and non-members, and RSVP at the link for Immersive X and join us for more talks from our XR Guild members from November 10-12 at Immersive X.

More info: https://immersive-x.de/sessions/building-the-xr-commons-from-shared-knowledge-to-community-owned-infrastructure
